hero.taglineHtml: Software engineer & technical founder with 15+ years in early-stage and growth companies. I build full-stack products from zero to scale — currently a Senior Software Engineer at Alltus, and previously at companies like Uber and Ethos Life.

experience.label: Experience
experience.heading: Software engineering experience
experience.intro: Fifteen years across operations, growth, and engineering — always as close to the problem as possible.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Building full-stack products and features as a key member of the engineering team.

roles.title: Founder & Software Engineer
bullets: Building an AI-powered job-discovery platform solo from the ground up.

Built an ingestion engine that discovers and de-dupes thousands of company job boards across every major ATS (Ashby, Greenhouse, and more), plus paid APIs and LinkedIn, into a unified relational database.
Implemented hybrid semantic search (pgvector + OpenAI embeddings fused with Postgres full-text ranking) and AI job-matching via Claude's Message Batches API for a ~50% cost reduction.
Shipped Stripe subscription billing, a per-user credit and cost-governance system, and a sharded cron pipeline for ingestion, scoring, embedding, and archival.

roles.title: Technical Cofounder / Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Sole software engineer, built a feature-rich practice management SaaS for mobile veterinarians from the ground up.
Processed over $20M in bookings and 30k+ appointments in under 3 years, with 99.99% uptime.
Shipped calendar management, online booking, SMS/email/phone comms, PDF generation, e-signing, invoicing, payments, inventory management, client portal, and medical records.
Integrated Stripe, SendGrid, Twilio, Google Calendar, Quickbooks, Datadog, Posthog, Slack, and more.

roles.title: Engineering Manager, Growth Team
bullets: Managed a team of 5 software engineers, fostering an environment of growth, collaboration, high performance, and career development.
Served as engineering lead for the growth team, supporting multiple product teams, building user-facing products.
Drove sprint planning and prioritization to keep projects on track and ensure company KPIs were being achieved.
Spearheaded engineering strategy, execution, and future product development.
Collaborated cross-functionally with product leaders and engineering managers to align technical objectives with broader business goals.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer, Growth Team
bullets: Architected consumer-facing products related to the application funnel for multiple D2C insurance products.
Designed, built, and maintained public and private APIs, ensuring scalability and security.
Partnered closely with design and product teams to ideate, develop, launch, and test new features driving growth.
Integrated with third-party software across various industries (insurance, identity verification, payments).

roles.title: Senior Manager, Risk & Fraud
bullets: Key role in scaling Uber's Risk team from 5 to 100+ employees while reducing loss rates by over 80%.
Investigated fraud attack vectors and developed rules, products, and features to reduce fraudulent activity.
Drove quarterly product planning and KPI tracking across six Product teams within the Risk organization.
Wrote fraud detection rules in Python and SQL to scope and block attack vectors.

roles.title: Senior Manager, Community Operations
bullets: Piloted and trained the first team of dedicated support reps at Uber — the foundation of a 20,000+ person support org.
Defined hundreds of support policies for riders and driver-partners around the world.
Managed a team of 7 and maintained a sub-12-hour support SLA across the West Coast region.

roles.title: Second Assistant
bullets: Researched startups for potential investments and assembled dossiers for evaluation.
Produced presentation decks for potential investors and business partners.

interests.label: Interests
interests.heading: Life outside of work
paragraphsHtml: When I'm not building software, you'll usually find me moving. I'm a regular at the gym, have run several marathons, and am working toward an IRONMAN. Skiing is a genuine passion — I've skied across the US and internationally, and have an ambition to ski on all seven continents. I'm also a big Formula 1 fan and try to catch as many races in person as I can.
I'm also a frequent traveler with a growing list of destinations. I live in Phoenix, AZ with my 2 beautiful huskies, and spend a lot of time on Hacker News when I'm not outdoors.
